title: Spoken alerts for TD Talk, TD Marketing, client messages and WhatsApp, in recorded voice
text: TD Talk, TD Marketing, portal chats and WhatsApp can now announce a new message out loud instead of beeping, naming who it is from (for example "New Luca message in TD Talk" or "Message from Rocco"; "New message from client" for portal chats). The announcements are recorded voice clips, so once Chrome is set to allow sound for the site the click-to-start bar no longer appears.
points: TD Talk's chat list has a Voice switch (on by default); the group named New implementation always says a new feature was posted and shows Read by N of M under each message.
While Voice is on, TD Talk plays a tone too quiet to hear so Chrome keeps a hidden tab awake; that had not been confirmed in practice when it shipped.
A hidden TD Talk tab catches up on chats whose unread count rose and announces them once, several chats in one line.
A person nobody recorded still falls back to the browser's voice, then to the beep.
